same_building_exclusions.name: Menor's Storehouse
same_building_exclusions.reason: A separate food-storage/root-cellar building; it is not the country-store wing attached to the homestead cabin.

same_building_exclusions.name: Maud Noble Cabin
same_building_exclusions.reason: A separate 1916 cabin moved to the Menor homestead in 1918 and documented as HABS WY-23.

same_building_exclusions.name: Menor's Ferry and cableworks
same_building_exclusions.reason: The present ferry and cableworks are replicas and are outside this building slice.

same_building_exclusions.name: Transportation Barn
same_building_exclusions.reason: The current barn stands only in the approximate location of Bill Menor's lost barn.

required_before_geometry: Acquire only the HABS WY-24 measured sheets, data pages, and photographs needed for the cabin/store geometry and registration.
Record retrieval date, resolved URL, item identifier, byte count, and SHA-256 for every acquired artifact.
Confirm drawing scale, north arrow, construction-phase boundaries, and elevation labels are legible before extracting measurements.
Hash terrain/public/buildings.json and record the exact named Homestead and Storehouse features used by the run.
required_before_projection: Resolve item-level authorship and rights for every selected HABS or NPS image.
Confirm each image shows Bill Menor's cabin and attached store rather than the separate storehouse, Maud Noble Cabin, ferry, or transportation barn.
Require at least two useful exterior elevations, including one that shows the cabin/store junction.
